description: Only tracks whose file size is strictly greater than 10,323,804 bytes are included.

c.request: Considering only tracks that pass a file-size (`Track.Bytes`) cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. Which media types have an average strictly higher than the simple average of all these per-media-type averages? Show the media type name, its average, and how far it is above that overall average (its average minus the overall average). Leave all values unrounded. Only tracks whose file size is strictly greater than 10,323,804 bytes are included.
c.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, avg_bpm AS average_bytes_per_ms, avg_bpm - (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM per) AS diff_from_overall FROM per WHERE avg_bpm > (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM per)

d.request: Considering only tracks with Bytes strictly greater than 10,323,804, compute for each media type name the average of Bytes divided by Milliseconds, then list the media types whose average is strictly higher than the simple (unweighted) mean of those per-media-type averages, showing the media type name, its average, and its average minus that overall mean, all unrounded.
d.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM per) SELECT p.name AS MediaTypeName, p.avg_ratio AS AvgBytesPerMs, p.avg_ratio - o.mean_avg AS DiffFromMean FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.mean_avg
